svg.title: UNESCO-listed and additional non-UNESCO stećak sites on a relief map
svg.desc: Red numbered circles 1–28 mark UNESCO component necropolises. Numbered blue circles 29–37 identify selected major non-UNESCO sites; two unnumbered blue circles are approximate locality references. Marker size increases with site-specific recorded counts where available. Sites with unknown counts use a visible minimum. Four crowded markers are nudged from their mapped coordinates with leader lines so circles do not cover neighboring site pins.
